subject: Acme catalog listing — request for SOC2 / pen test / DPA artifacts
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan@acme-retail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:12:00Z
Subject: Request: evidence for Acme listing in Cloud Catalog

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for walking us through the co-sell flow this morning. As we prepare the Acme listing for the cloud catalogs (AWS & GCP initially), Procurement/Security asked us to collect vendor artifacts to attach to the listing and to pass to our internal marketplace team. Can you share the following: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (summary or AICPA letter is fine)
- Penetration test letter or attestation (redacted results are OK)
- Executed DPA or a standard DPA we can route through our legal
- Any regional data residency notes (AWS eu-west/GCP us-central etc.)
- Contact for SOC2 evidence questions (email + phone)

I've attached our short questionnaire (Acme-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx) — if you can populate the relevant fields and return, that would speed review.

Timeline: our marketplace deadline is Dec 7 — ideally we get the artifacts by Dec 2 to avoid last-minute legal review. Is that feasible?

Apologies for the short notice. Looping in Aisha (legal) on copy.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Cloud Integrations
Acme Retail

Attachment: Acme-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for Acme listing in Cloud Catalog

Hi Jordan — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet.

Short answers: yes, we can provide the artifacts you list. I've attached the following to get started: 
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page summary of scope and monitoring cadence)
- redwood-pen-test-letter-redacted.pdf (attestation letter; details redacted for vendor privacy)
- Redwood-DPA-v3.docx (editable template that our legal is ok to start from)

Link: I've also dropped a small evidence bundle and a matrix into a shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-evidence — that has a checklist that should align with your questionnaire.

Notes / caveats:
- Full SOC2 report contains confidential control narratives. We can provide a SOC2 bridge letter or a secure viewer link if Acme's legal needs the full report for diligence.
- Pen test: we provide a signed attestation and a redacted report for vendors; full raw findings require an NDA.
- DPA: our standard DPA supports EU data transfers via SCCs; if you have a redline please send to legal@redwood.com and we'll route to our counsel.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can fill the questionnaire sections we own and return by EOD Nov 26.
2) Karthik + Jonas — can you confirm whether the redacted pen-test letter and SOC2 summary are sufficient for marketplace ingestion, or do we need to prepare a secure share (NDA) for their legal?
3) Jordan/Aisha — please confirm the legal reviewer and whether Acme needs DocuSign on the DPA or prefers to redline first.

We're aiming to meet your Dec 2 handoff; if anything blocks that timeline we'll escalate.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-pen-test-letter-redacted.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v3.docx

Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for Acme listing in Cloud Catalog

Karthik / Jonas — forwarding Acme's questionnaire and my reply. Quick asks:

- Karthik: please confirm whether our SOC2 summary page is okay for Azure/AWS catalog ingestion or whether we should provision a secure viewer link. Also confirm which template we should use for DPA negotiation (Redwood-DPA-v3 or standard enterprise DPA).
- Jonas: our pen-test letter is redacted; legal sometimes requests the scope statement. Can you confirm if we can add a one-line scope (e.g., "external network + application layer; Nov 2025") to the attestation without exposing vendor specifics?

Goal: provide a completed set back to Jordan by EOD Nov 29 so they can hit Dec 2. If this looks tight, flag and I'll escalate to legal and sales ops.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Stephanie — this is perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. Aisha and I reviewed the SOC2 summary and the pen-test attestation; both are sufficient for our listing team. Aisha confirms Acme legal is happy to receive the DPA via DocuSign (link works).

Two quick items:
- Could you add the one-line pen-test scope (as Jonas suggested) to the attestation? That will help our security reviewers.
- For the SOC2, if you can provide an exportable "control mapping" (mapping SOC control to your customer-facing controls) that's handy but not required for the catalog. If you can deliver that by Dec 1, we should be on track.

I'll schedule a 30-minute handoff call for Dec 1 — invite forthcoming.

Thanks again —
Jordan
